resources.string: VictorCam is a virtual camera feed tool for privacy testing, streaming demos, and playing back user-owned content into apps that use Camera2 or CameraX.\n\nIt is NOT for fraud, KYC or biometric bypass, impersonation, or any deceptive identity presentation. Use only with content you own or have rights to, and only in contexts where a virtual camera is appropriate and permitted.
User-owned content only — not for fraud, KYC/biometric bypass, or impersonation.
No EXTRA_OUTPUT — result Intent will carry a thumbnail / content Uri.
Capturing a screen region for the virtual feed (user-owned / demo use).

HARD WARNINGS

• Root / LSPosed can brick or compromise your device.
• This path is OFF by default and requires explicit opt-in.
• User-owned content only — NOT for fraud, KYC/biometric bypass, or impersonation.
• Banking, payment, government ID, and KYC apps are hard-denylisted and cannot be hooked.
• Scope is per-app opt-in only.
Stock Android: audio plays for preview / our capture intents only. System mic replace needs root/LSPosed.
